name: Tzatziki Pasta Salad with Chickpeas, Mixed Veggies, Olives & Feta
instructions: Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, place tzatziki, vinaigrette, and spices in a large bowl. Stir to combine the dressing.
Drain and rinse chickpeas. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Wash, dry, trim, and small dice cucumber. Add to the bowl.
Wash, dry, and halve tomatoes lengthwise. Add to the bowl along with the carrots.
Thinly slice olives. Add to the bowl.
When the pasta is done, drain and rinse under cold water to cool. Add to the bowl with the chickpeas and veggies, then stir to combine the pasta salad.
To serve, divide pasta salad between plates or bowls and top with feta. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
